* *

The three components are joined with {@code '|'} and hashed with SHA-256, yielding a 64-character * lower-case hex string. The telephone is normalized to its E.164 form (see {@link E164Telephone}); a * value that cannot form a valid E.164 number is used verbatim so the key stays defined for every * stored owner. The email contributes its lower-cased form, or the empty string when absent. The last * name contributes its {@link Soundex} code, so phonetically identical surnames share this component. * *

Two owners are duplicates only when their WHOLE identityKey is equal. Because the telephone is * part of the key, owners with the same surname (and postcode) but different telephones have * different keys and are both allowed — they are flagged as a soft match rather than rejected. */ public final class IdentityKey { private IdentityKey() { } public static String of(Owner owner) { String raw = normalizeTelephone(owner.getTelephone()) + "|" + normalizeEmail(owner.getEmail()) + "|" + Soundex.of(owner.getLastName()); return sha256Hex(raw); } private static String sha256Hex(String value) { try { byte[] digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256") .digest(value.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)); StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(digest.length * 2); for (byte b : digest) { sb.append(String.format("%02x", b)); } return sb.toString(); } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException e) { throw new IllegalStateException("SHA-256 not available", e); } } private static String normalizeTelephone(String telephone) { try { return E164Telephone.normalize(telephone); } catch (InvalidTelephoneException ex) { return telephone == null ? **customerCode collision:** `AssignCustomerCode.java` lines 30-42:
```java

for (Owner other : ownerRepository.findAll()) {
    String code = other.getCustomerCode();

String candidate = base;
for (int n = 2; existing.contains(candidate); n++) {
```

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "The honorific title of the pet owner. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS, DR. When supplied it prefixes the derived 'salutation'."
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' are supplied they are preferred and this field is returned as the composed, normalized address."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: "The first line of the owner's structured postal address. When supplied (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address' input; normalized like 'address'."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: "The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. When present it is appended, after a single space, to the normalized 'addressLine1' to form the composed 'address'."
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional; when supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares the same last name and postcode (the same household); such a request is created as a declared household member instead of being rejected as a duplicate. Optional; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: "The canonical URI of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>' using the owner's id."
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's salutation formatted as '<title> <lastName>', or just the last name when no title was supplied."
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: "The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678')."
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION is the canonical region derived from the postcode (postcode-preferred, city-table fallback) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone + lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Assigned membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the year the fiscal year ends in. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a date from 1 July onward belongs to the fiscal year ending the following 30 June."
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic shared identifier for the owner's household, the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode. All owners of the same last name and postcode share this value automatically; null when the owner has no postcode.
              type: string
              example: '3F9A2C1D5E8B'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The derived duplicate-detection key, formed as normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId. Two owners collide (409 on create) only when their whole identityKey is equal."
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3F9A2C1D5E8B'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "Numeric membership points assigned on creation. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3 or more; add 3 for a tenure over one elapsed fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric membership level assigned on creation, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: "The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the customerCode (the region-and-hash identity)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The canonical region, taken as the REGION part of the customerCode ('<REGION>-<HASH8>'); this is the region derived from the postcode (postcode-preferred, city-table fallback: Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The IANA timezone name derived from the locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane); null when the region is not one of these."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's registration day before this owner was created, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: "True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the capacity limit of 50) before this owner was created, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: "True when, although not a hard duplicate, this owner shares an existing owner's last name and postcode with a different telephone; otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: "The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of, when 'possibleDuplicate' is true; otherwise null."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band derived from birthDate, computed as full years from birthDate to registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18-64, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied."
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: "The owner's marketing segment '<TIER>_<AREA>': TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'; AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of PREMIUM_METRO, PREMIUM_REGIONAL, STANDARD_METRO, STANDARD_REGIONAL."
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: "True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id}; the record is retained and still readable. False for a newly created owner."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:

          description: Pet owners in the requested page.

          minimum: 0

        totalPages:

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:

    PetPage:

          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "The honorific title of the pet owner. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS, DR. When supplied it prefixes the derived 'salutation'."
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' are supplied they are preferred and this field is returned as the composed, normalized address."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: "The first line of the owner's structured postal address. When supplied (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address' input; normalized like 'address'."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: "The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. When present it is appended, after a single space, to the normalized 'addressLine1' to form the composed 'address'."
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional; when supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares the same last name and postcode (the same household); such a request is created as a declared household member instead of being rejected as a duplicate. Optional; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: "The canonical URI of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>' using the owner's id."
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's salutation formatted as '<title> <lastName>', or just the last name when no title was supplied."
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: "The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678')."
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: "Assigned member ID formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': REGION is the canonical region derived from the postcode (postcode-preferred, city-table fallback); FY is the two-digit fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate; HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone + lastName; and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of <REGION><FY><HASH8>."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the year the fiscal year ends in. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a date from 1 July onward belongs to the fiscal year ending the following 30 June."
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic shared identifier for the owner's household, the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode. All owners of the same last name and postcode share this value automatically; null when the owner has no postcode.
              type: string
              example: '3F9A2C1D5E8B'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The derived duplicate-detection key, formed as normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId. Two owners collide (409 on create) only when their whole identityKey is equal."
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3F9A2C1D5E8B'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "Numeric membership points assigned on creation. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3 or more; add 3 for a tenure over one elapsed fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric membership level assigned on creation, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: "The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the customerCode (the region-and-hash identity)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The canonical region, taken as the REGION part of the customerCode ('<REGION>-<HASH8>'); this is the region derived from the postcode (postcode-preferred, city-table fallback: Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The IANA timezone name derived from the locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane); null when the region is not one of these."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's registration day before this owner was created, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: "True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the capacity limit of 50) before this owner was created, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: "True when, although not a hard duplicate, this owner shares an existing owner's last name and postcode with a different telephone; otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: "The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of, when 'possibleDuplicate' is true; otherwise null."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band derived from birthDate, computed as full years from birthDate to registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18-64, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied."
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: "The owner's marketing segment '<TIER>_<AREA>': TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'; AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of PREMIUM_METRO, PREMIUM_REGIONAL, STANDARD_METRO, STANDARD_REGIONAL."
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: "True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id}; the record is retained and still readable. False for a newly created owner."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.

        totalElements:
          title: Total elements

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "The honorific title of the pet owner. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS, DR. When supplied it prefixes the derived 'salutation'."
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' are supplied they are preferred and this field is returned as the composed, normalized address."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: "The first line of the owner's structured postal address. When supplied (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address' input; normalized like 'address'."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: "The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. When present it is appended, after a single space, to the normalized 'addressLine1' to form the composed 'address'."
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional; when supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares the same last name and postcode (the same household); such a request is created as a declared household member instead of being rejected as a duplicate. Optional; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: "The canonical URI of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>' using the owner's id."
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's salutation formatted as '<title> <lastName>', or just the last name when no title was supplied."
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: "The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678')."
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: "Assigned member ID formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': REGION is the canonical region derived from the postcode (postcode-preferred, city-table fallback); FY is the two-digit fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate; HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone + lastName; and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of <REGION><FY><HASH8>."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the year the fiscal year ends in. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a date from 1 July onward belongs to the fiscal year ending the following 30 June."
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic shared identifier for the owner's household, the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode. All owners of the same last name and postcode share this value automatically; null when the owner has no postcode.
              type: string
              example: '3F9A2C1D5E8B'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The derived duplicate-detection key, formed as normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId. Two owners collide (409 on create) only when their whole identityKey is equal."
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3F9A2C1D5E8B'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "Numeric membership points assigned on creation. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3 or more; add 3 for a tenure over one elapsed fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric membership level assigned on creation, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The canonical region, taken as the REGION part of the customerCode ('<REGION>-<HASH8>'); this is the region derived from the postcode (postcode-preferred, city-table fallback: Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The IANA timezone name derived from the locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane); null when the region is not one of these."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's registration day before this owner was created, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: "True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the capacity limit of 50) before this owner was created, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: "True when, although not a hard duplicate, this owner shares an existing owner's last name and postcode with a different telephone; otherwise false."
              type: boolean

# Idempotent create: if this request carries an 'Idempotency-Key' already seen from a prior
# successful create, replay the originally created owner (200) instead of creating a duplicate.
# Runs first, before any validation or duplicate check, and publishes the key for recordIdempotency.
checkIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotencyKey
  next: validate

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  next: validatePostcode

# Validate the postcode WHEN PRESENT (optional when absent), so an out-of-range postcode
# for the city's region is a 400 before the owner is built.
validatePostcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerPostcode
  next: validateRegistrationDate

# Reject a SUPPLIED registrationDate later than the server date as a 400, before the date is
# resolved/defaulted. A request that omits the date stays accepted.
validateRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateRegistrationDate
  next: normalizeTelephone

normalizeTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerTelephone
  next: normalizeEmail

normalizeEmail:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerEmail
  next: rejectDisposableEmail

# Reject a supplied email whose domain is on the disposable-domain blocklist as a 400. Runs after
# normalizeEmail so the domain is already syntactically valid and lower-cased.
rejectDisposableEmail:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RejectDisposableEmailDomain
  next: resolveRegistrationDate

# Resolve the effective registration date (supplied-or-default, rolled forward off weekends)
# before the daily limit, so the limit counts owners per the same adjusted business day.
resolveRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ResolveRegistrationDate
  next: ensureCityCapacity

ensureCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureDailyLimit

ensureDailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureDailyLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureUniqueIdentity

# Consolidated duplicate detection: reject 409 only when the new owner's WHOLE derived identityKey
# (SHA-256 hex over normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)) equals an existing owner's.
# The identityKey is the single identity rule; the computed householdId no longer contributes.
ensureUniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueIdentity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: flagPossibleDuplicate

# Soft duplicate: not a hard identity collision (already rejected above), but its identityKey differs
# while soundex(lastName) and postcode both match an existing owner. Still created; flagged with
# possibleDuplicate/possibleDuplicateOf so the response can surface the likely match.
flagPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.FlagPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdSize

assignHouseholdSize:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdSize
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: defaultRegistrationDate

defaultRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.DefaultOwnerRegistrationDate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCustomerCode

assignCustomerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignBulkSignupWarning

assignBulkSignupWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCapacityWarning

# Flag capacityWarning when the owner's city already held 40-49 owners (approaching the hard limit
# of 50). Runs before save, so the owner being created is not yet persisted and never counts itself.
assignCapacityWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCapacityWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: capMembershipLevel

# Capture the household-capped membershipLevel: the naturally computed level, but no more than one
# above the current maximum among existing household members. Runs after householdSize/namesakeCount
# are set (the level's inputs) and before save, so the capped value is persisted.
capMembershipLevel:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CapMembershipLevel
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

# Emit an AUDIT line for the created owner (id assigned by save) before responding.
audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: recordIdempotency

# Remember this request's Idempotency-Key -> new owner id (when a key was supplied) so a later
# repeat with the same key replays this owner instead of creating a duplicate.
recordIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotencyKey
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
